_doc: World golden scene list (presentation lane; ART-01 look-dev entries, TA-24 terrain and Z-plan entries). Each entry renders one PNG at 1280x720 on the Compatibility renderer: run `godot --path godot --rendering-driver opengl3 <scene> -- <args> --shot=<out.png>`; entries with measure=true also print LOOKDEV_MEASURE / LOOKDEV_NIGHT_TARGET lines that must stay inside `tolerance` (fraction). Images are not committed (CLAUDE.md); TA-35 adds the nightly runner and the perceptual compare keyed by adapter string. device status: pc = rendered locally, xvfb_llvmpipe = needs the ci lane to loop this list in nightly.yml golden-screenshots, android_mid / web_mobile = PENDING HUMAN (HUM-06 devices). Source: docs/spikes/ART-01/REPORT.md. TA-24: entries with measure="flicker" are the 03 s7.7 z-fighting harness (z_scene.tscn): they print Z_POSE / Z_RESULT lines and exit non-zero when flicker_max_pct > 2.0 (a deliberate coplanar pair, --control, must exceed it: 16.5 % measured); the tier is selected with --tier=low|medium|high.
